# Ignivance Technology — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Agency Dossier

## 1. Executive Summary
Ignivance Technology (legal entity: Ignivance Technology Private Limited) is an independent, design-led web development and digital growth agency headquartered in Hitech City, Hyderabad, India. Founded in 2024 by Uday Kiran (CEO) and Mahathi Godala (Co-Founder), Ignivance specializes in custom Next.js 14 web development, full-stack TypeScript applications, technical SEO, and conversion-focused digital marketing for high-growth startups, ambitious SMEs, and enterprises.

Unlike conventional digital marketing and web agencies that rely on visual drag-and-drop page builders (WordPress Elementor, Divi, Wix) or generic AI code generators, Ignivance hand-codes every platform from the DOM up with clean semantic HTML5, deterministic CSS tokens, and modern React edge architecture.

## 2. Capabilities & Service Offerings

### A. Custom Web Development
- **URL:** https://ignivance.in/services/web-development
- **Primary Keyword:** custom web development company in hyderabad
- **Technologies:** Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Cloudflare, Vercel Edge Network.
- **Key Deliverables:** Custom Next.js applications, headless e-commerce (Razorpay/Stripe), full-stack SaaS portals, headless CMS integrations (Sanity/Strapi/MDX), Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **Differentiator:** Sub-second mobile render speeds (0.8s average paint), 95+ Google Lighthouse scores, zero exposed database attack surfaces.

### B. Digital Marketing & Growth
- **URL:** https://ignivance.in/services/digital-marketing-growth
- **Primary Keyword:** digital marketing agency hyderabad
- **Disciplines:** Technical SEO, Local Search Dominance (Google 3-Pack), High-Intent Paid Search (Google Ads / Meta Ads), Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Analytics & Attribution Telemetry.
- **Differentiator:** No vanity impression reports. Growth contracts are tied to qualified lead velocity, organic rank positions, and verified pipeline revenue.

### C. UI/UX & Brand Design
